entries.name: Air Elemental

source.name: Air Elemental

additionalSources.name: D&D Monster Manual (2000), Air Elemental and Whirlwind

source.evidence: Air Elemental, Large labels the endpoint of one class. At level 5 the creature is Medium, with 4d8 Hit Dice, CR 2, Whirlwind, and a 1d6 slam. Whirlwind uses the core 3.0 rules with the damage and saving throw adjustments on p. 153.
source.catalogStatus: Existing monster or beast record only at the batch baseline.

entries.name: Alseid
entries.aliases: Alseid deer-centaur; keep separate from Centaur

source.name: Alseid
source.heading: Alseid Traits
sourceDistinctions: The playable Alseid is a Monstrosity. Its Quadruped trait gives specific movement constraints. Woodfriend applies within forests.

entries.name: Annis Hag
entries.aliases: Annis; keep separate from Green Hag and Sea Hag

source.name: Annis Hag
source.evidence: Table A–2 is the Annis Hag player progression. Green Hag and Sea Hag each have separate classes. The worked build stops at level 11 after Rend and before Tear.
source.catalogStatus: Missing playable profile at batch baseline. Creature records exist.

entries.name: Aranea
entries.aliases: Aranea monster class; Herath and Savage Coast PC rules remain separate

source.name: Aranea

additionalSources.name: Monster Manual (2000), Aranea, p. 19 (web and form details)

source.evidence: The printed progression supplies player uses, casting and poison damage. Applied the 2000 Monster Manual web detail as the class directs. The Herath and Savage Coast options have separate publication keys.
source.catalogStatus: Missing Savage Species profile at batch baseline. Other playable publications are indexed.

entries.name: Athach
entries.aliases: Athach monster class

source.name: Athach
source.evidence: The third arm is available from level 1. Bite begins at 2 and Strength poison at 3. Level 3 uses its own printed base saves +1/+1/+3, avoiding the apparent level-2 Fortitude typo. Large size and bonus Multiattack both arrive at level 9.
source.catalogStatus: Missing playable profile at batch baseline.

entries.name: Barghest
entries.aliases: Barghest; greater barghest is a progression outcome, not another claim

source.name: Barghest
source.evidence: Barghest is a single approved claim. Greater barghest belongs to the creature's advancement history. The worked example uses the player Feed bonus and advances Hit Dice by level rather than by feeding.
source.catalogStatus: Missing playable profile at batch baseline. Creature records exist.

entries.name: Bugbear
entries.aliases: Bugbear player profile; exclude monster and 5e records

source.name: Bugbear
sourceDistinctions: This is the DM-permission player and NPC profile from the racial appendix. It has player-scale ability adjustments and the racial encounter version of Predatory Eye.
The encounter build uses a Medium mace. Oversized permits a Large mace, and a larger weapon is optional.

entries.name: Cayma
entries.aliases: Cayma; keep separate from Gurrash and Shazak

source.name: Cayma
sourceDistinctions: Use the sourcebook’s Cayma PC rules and thief modifiers. Detect magic belongs to the Savage Warrior kit. The example uses the Scout thief kit.
Ground movement 9 comes from Lizard Kin in the 1996 Monstrous Compendium Appendix, reflow p. 65. The build uses class hit dice, THAC0 and saves.

supportingSources.title: Savage Coast Campaign Book (1996), Player Characters

entries.name: Djinni
entries.aliases: Djinn; Djinni genie, distinct from Jinnborn

source.name: Djinni

additionalSources.name: Monster Manual (2000), Djinni, pp. 95–96 (Air Mastery and Whirlwind)

source.evidence: The heading names Air and Good; the first row explicitly grants Air, Chaotic, and Good. The class sets the whirlwind's daily uses and refers to the contemporary Monster Manual for dimensions, damage, saves, and duration. The worked example uses those printed values.
source.catalogStatus: Missing playable profile at batch baseline. Creature records exist.

entries.name: Drider
entries.aliases: Drider monster class

source.name: Drider
source.evidence: The class does not grant web spinning. The worked example selects web as a 2nd-level sorcerer spell when the class reaches four Hit Dice. The class feature text explicitly grants two feats at first level, while the first table row records a single feat.
source.catalogStatus: Missing playable profile at batch baseline. Creature records exist.

entries.name: Drow
entries.aliases: Dark elf; exclude Drow Half-Elf and other edition scopes

source.name: Drow
sourceDistinctions: This racial appendix recommends DM permission for player characters. The Forgotten Realms Player’s Guide prints a separate player profile.
The printed Monster Manual rule gives Drow Darkvision and lets Lolthtouched fuel either racial power once in each encounter.

entries.name: Ee’aar
entries.aliases: Ee'aar; winged elf is descriptive; keep separate from Avariel

source.name: Ee’aar
sourceDistinctions: The example uses the player flight rate of 18 (B), the Aeryla language and the book’s specific weapon bonuses and spell resistance. The Monstrous Compendium Appendix uses faster flight and different language names.
Ground movement 16 alone comes from the Appendix’s Ee’aar entry, reflow p. 27. The GM can replace it with the table’s standard humanoid ground rate.

supportingSources.title: Savage Coast Campaign Book (1996), Player Characters

entries.name: Efreeti

source.name: Efreeti

additionalSources.name: Savage Species, 3.0 fire subtype example on p. 169
Wizards of the Coast, original SRD spells in the complete 2004 compilation

source.evidence: Heat first appears at level 2. Level 3 grants produce flame and pyrotechnics at will. Flight arrives at level 4, Large size at level 10, and wish at level 18. The class grants no command spell. Its telepathy supports the quartermaster’s orders.
source.catalogStatus: Missing playable profile at batch baseline.

entries.name: Enduk
entries.aliases: Enduks; winged minotaur is descriptive; keep separate from Minotaur

source.name: Enduk
sourceDistinctions: The playable profile sets the flight rate and uses a height threshold for Large size. The Monstrous Compendium Appendix lists other flight and size values.
Ground movement 15 alone comes from the Appendix’s Enduk entry, reflow p. 29. The sourcebook supplies Idu’s faith and the natural gore damage.

Master Trickster is a minor use of Ghost Sound once per encounter. Fade Away is a separate encounter reaction. Page 11 gives the Small character weapon rules.

entries.name: Grig

source.name: Grig
